programs.title: My Bakery in Brooklyn
programs.desc: When Chloe and Vivien inherit their aunt's bakery the sparks fly as each has very different ideas for it's future. The solution - a line down the middle of the shop. But will a little romance put some icing on these hot cakes?

programs.title: The Mambo Kings
programs.desc: Two Cuban brothers bring a new music to 1950s USA. They are as different as the problems that await them.

programs.title: The Onion Movie
programs.desc: Satirical interpretations of world events and curious human behavior.

programs.title: Women and Men Stories of Seduction
programs.desc: Three short tales, each featuring a man and a woman. The first one takes place in the 1940s, while the other two are set in the 1920s. In The Man in a Brooks Brothers Suit, a businessman showers a young Leftist woman with drinks on a train. They spend the night together, and he thinks he's fallen for her; she seems to go along with it. In Dusk Before Fireworks, Kit, a lively flapper, visits Hoby's fancy apartment hoping for a night of romance, but constant phone break the mood. In Hills Like White Elephants, a couple traveling through Spain talk about her pregnancy: he wants things to remain the same, but she's unsure about what she wants.

programs.title: Radio Rebel
programs.desc: Tara (Debby Ryan) -  a painfully shy high-schooler, has a secret: she is also a confident DJ known as Radio Rebel, who lends her voice to others.

programs.title: Candid about Love
programs.desc: Laura, a gallery assistant and wannabe fine art photographer, is finally promised a spot in a Newcomer’s Showcase - but only if she can get a reclusive artist, Shane, to premiere his newest photographs at the gallery. When Laura discovers that Shane hasn’t taken a new photo in ten years, she’s determined to help him find his way back to his art whether he wants her to or not.
